card.name: Should in antidepressant suicide warning
card.fires_on: The word "should" right after "Patients of all ages who are started on antidepressant therapy" in the suicide-risk warning about depression and antidepressants.

modes.label: Monitoring warning sentence
modes.description: "should" that begins the instruction to monitor patients starting antidepressant therapy, in the suicidality warning text.
modes.example: Patients of all ages who are started on antidepressant therapy<< should>> be monitored appropriately and observed closely for clinical

card.plain: It lights up on the word "should" in the standard warning that patients starting antidepressants need close monitoring.
